nodes.label: Result / Result<T>
nodes.rationale: Business outcomes are returned as values, not exceptions.

nodes.label: Money (decimal + Currency UZS)
nodes.rationale: Single rounding rule: 2 dp, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero; numeric(19,2) bound.

nodes.label: ITransactionRunner / TransactionRunner
nodes.rationale: Success Result commits, failed Result rolls back; only 40001/40P01 retried up to 3 times then 409 common.concurrency.

nodes.label: IRowLocks / RowLocks
nodes.rationale: Lock order branch -> appointment -> others prevents deadlocks.

nodes.label: IAuditLog / AuditLog (append-only audit.audit_log)
nodes.rationale: Audit is written in the same transaction as the business change; details contain only ids and codes.

nodes.label: ClientHeaderMiddleware (CSRF X-OqTish-Client)
nodes.rationale: CSRF defence (OD-23): non-GET /api requests require X-OqTish-Client header; runs before authentication.

nodes.label: IPasswordHashService / PasswordHashService
nodes.rationale: Uses Identity PasswordHasher without Identity user store (ADR-016); VerifyDummy equalises timing for unknown accounts.

nodes.label: StartupGuards
nodes.rationale: Production refuses dangerous settings (Fake SMS/Telegram, weak pepper, bad webhook config).

nodes.label: OtpService
nodes.rationale: SMS sent directly after commit, not via outbox (ADR-018); decoy challenge for unknown phones.

nodes.label: Identity handlers (OTP, password, Telegram, TOTP, sessions)
DeleteAccountHandler
nodes.rationale: Account deletion anonymises (OD-18) rather than hard-deletes.

nodes.label: AccessScope.Check
nodes.rationale: Cross-tenant -> 404, in-tenant missing permission -> 403.

nodes.label: StaffRules (anti-escalation)
nodes.rationale: Staff changes per clinic serialised by advisory lock so two parallel demotions cannot bypass last-owner rule.

nodes.label: PlatformAdminBootstrapCommand (create-platform-admin)
nodes.rationale: Password never on argv: env var or stdin only.

nodes.label: Database time only (IDbClock / statement_timestamp)
nodes.rationale: now() freezes at transaction start and would let a late confirm waiting on a lock slip through; clock_timestamp/statement_timestamp are used instead.

nodes.label: Least-flexible-first doctor candidate heuristic
nodes.rationale: Greedy heuristic; B5 test documents an unsolvable case; staff can swap the doctor at confirm.

nodes.label: Sweep-on-write
nodes.rationale: Correctness does not depend on the background sweeper; overdue Pending rows are expired before every booking write.

nodes.label: Booking locking strategy (READ COMMITTED + explicit locks + constraints)
nodes.rationale: Fixed lock order (idempotency key -> branch -> patient advisory -> appointment -> blocks); sweeper uses SKIP LOCKED so no deadlock cycles (ADR-005).

nodes.label: Doctor time-block exclusion constraint (23P01)
nodes.rationale: Final guarantee against double booking across branches/walk-ins/time-off; without it 12 of 20 succeeded in experiment.

nodes.label: Booking notification contract (outbox intents, AppointmentNotice)
nodes.rationale: Phone and name never in payloads (OD-10).

nodes.label: Double-entry append-only ledger
nodes.rationale: Ledger is the single source of truth; corrections only via reversal entries; source_event_key UNIQUE for idempotency.

nodes.label: PeriodLock
nodes.rationale: Postings into a closed (Finalized/Paid) month are moved to the next open month (BE3-6).

nodes.label: Commission flow (no default rule, snapshot per line)
nodes.rationale: No invented commission terms: without a rule commission is 0 and reports say so.

nodes.label: OutboxDispatcher / OutboxDispatcherService
nodes.rationale: At-least-once delivery; dedup key bounds duplicates; delivery failure never affects business data.

nodes.label: IOutboxClaimer / OutboxClaimer (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED lease)

hyperedges.label: Finance ledger posting and reconciliation pipeline
